Aditi Bansal
Senior QA Automation Engineer | Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra
aditi.bansal905@example.com | +91 9616202056

Experienced QA automation engineer with a strong background in building reliable test frameworks and driving quality across API and UI platforms. Skilled at translating product requirements into automated test suites, integrating them into CI pipelines, and reducing release regression risk. Open to relocation anywhere in India. Notice period: 15 days.

Experience

Trellis Systems, Nov 2024 - Present
Senior QA Automation Engineer — Remote
- Designed and implemented a Java-based UI automation framework using Selenium, reducing manual regression time by 60% and cutting release verification from 8 hours to under 3 hours.
- Built and maintained Postman collections for API contract and smoke testing; automated nightly collection runs and reported failures to Jira, catching 12 critical API regressions in the first quarter.
- Integrated Java test suites with Jenkins to enable parallel execution on CI; optimized test execution to achieve 4x faster feedback and decreased pipeline flakiness by 35%.
- Collaborated with product and backend teams to define acceptance criteria and implemented automated checks that improved production stability, measurable by a 28% drop in critical bugs post-release.

PhonePe, Dec 2018 - Oct 2024
SDET — Onsite
- Developed pytest-based API and integration test suites for core payment flows, increasing automated coverage of high-risk endpoints to 82% and preventing several transaction regressions during major launches.
- Led Test Automation initiatives to migrate legacy functional tests into automated pipelines, resulting in a 50% reduction in manual test effort and faster sprint sign-offs.
- Implemented continuous test execution with Jenkins and tied results into Jira for traceability; reduced mean time to detect release issues by 40%.
- Mentored junior engineers on pytest best practices and Test Automation design patterns, improving team productivity and lowering defect escapes to production.

Projects
- CI Regression Dashboard: Created a dashboard aggregating Jenkins test run statistics and Jira bug trends to help release managers prioritize fixes; contributed to a 20% faster triage process.
- API Contract Suite: Built a reusable Postman-driven contract validation library used across multiple teams to ensure backward compatibility during deployments.

Skills
Languages: Java, Python
Automation: Selenium, Test Automation, pytest
API & Tools: Postman, Jenkins, Jira

Education
B.Tech, Electronics, NIT Trichy
